cuts.label: scout:xqc/xqc-call-doubl-2026w41
cuts.title: xQc goes all in on a casino slot, then blackjack hits
cuts.hook: xQc's all-in casino day in GTA NoPixel
cuts.retelling: xQc goes all in on a GTA NoPixel slot machine and watches it fail, then an hour later bets big at blackjack and wins.

cuts.label: scout:xqc/xqc-along-believe-2026w41
cuts.title: xQc vs the NoPixel cops
cuts.retelling: xQc keeps getting caught by the NoPixel cops: first they catch him in the water after a dock chase, then hours later a cop pulls him over and says his car is stolen.

cuts.label: ohnepixel@vod2889800273/ohnepixel-ohnepixel-says-2026w43
cuts.title: Ohnepixel swears he quit this game
cuts.hook: Ohnepixel swears he quit this game
cuts.retelling: Ohnepixel says he's done with a suggestive mobile game, then the game comes back on and he flusters, insisting to chat that he's not playing it.

cuts.label: atrioc@vod2911839883/atrioc-anyone-atrioc-2026w44
cuts.title: Atrioc drops out of TwitchCon, then does a hard pivot to a Star Wars soundboard
cuts.hook: Atrioc drops TwitchCon, then pivots hard
cuts.retelling: Atrioc says he pulled out of a TwitchCon panel to avoid making anyone uncomfortable, admits it's stressful, then abruptly pivots to a Star Wars soundboard button and fumbles with timers while chat roasts him.

cuts.label: pokimane@vod2886637167/pokimane-baby-condolenc-2026w40
cuts.title: Pokimane on stream: Mimi has been with me
cuts.retelling: Pokimane tearfully tells her stream that her pet Mimi got out onto the balcony after the cleaners opened it, and that she can't believe Mimi is gone.

cuts.label: scout:ishowspeed/ishowspeed-about-card-2026w41
cuts.title: IShowSpeed's FC 27 luck is cursed
cuts.retelling: IShowSpeed's first FC 27 session goes badly: he begs the packs for one more walkout, rages that an opponent only spams Pelé, then melts down at the ref in a later match.

cuts.label: scout:kaicenat/kaicenat-asks-cenat-2026w44
cuts.title: Kai Cenat's wildest moments in Japan
cuts.retelling: Kai Cenat's Japan trip keeps turning into chaos with strangers: fans mob him in the street, one fan gets quizzed on whether he's a real fan, and a samurai show in Kyoto ends with performers jumping him.

cuts.label: scout:ohnepixel/ohnepixel-actually-bett-2026w41
cuts.title: Ohnepixel can't stop saying "I'm done"
cuts.retelling: A streamer keeps swearing he's done with a suggestive mobile game, then gets caught playing it again and insists to chat that he isn't.

cuts.label: kaicenat@vod2888642092/kaicenat-call-cenat-2026w40
cuts.title: Kai Cenat Shows Reggie's Texts And Call History
cuts.hook: Kai says Reggie's texts prove he lied
cuts.retelling: Kai Cenat reads his texts and call history with his former friend Reggie to say Reggie lied about needing help, then points out that the evidence Reggie promised never showed up.

cuts.label: scout:stableronaldo/stableronaldo-goes-neck-2026w40
cuts.title: Stableronaldo's streams keep ending in screaming
cuts.hook: Stableronaldo's streams keep ending in screaming
cuts.retelling: Stableronaldo screams at the man he's working with, then days later screams over and over in a 2v1 fight, so his streams keep blowing up into yelling.

cuts.label: scout:jasontheween+stableronaldo/jasontheween-stableronaldo-boxing-canva-2026w44
cuts.title: NMS Boxing 5: the referee hit the canvas, then the knockdown
cuts.retelling: At NMS Boxing 5 the commentators praise a great first fight, the referee ends up on his hands and knees, and then another streamer asks to see a knockdown replay and calls it insane.
